decisions.decision: Minutes of the June 28, 2018 meeting were accepted (no motion recorded).
decisions.quote: minutes of the june 28, 2018 meeting were accepted.

decisions.decision: A survey on the SWTF webpage and an article in the Ledger inviting community participation should be undertaken (MCM 2).
decisions.quote: it was determined that a survey posted on the swtf webpage, as well as an article in the ledger which advertises the survey

decisions.decision: The Stormwater Management Plan should be posted on the website.
decisions.quote: the stormwater management plan (swmp), which should be ready by october-november, according to ed himlan, should also be posted on the website.

decisions.decision: The Storm Sewer Overflow (SSO) Inventory must be completed by June 30, 2019.
decisions.quote: it was determined that the storm sewer overflow (sso) inventory must be completed by june 30, 2019.

decisions.decision: The stormwater bylaws are to be reviewed to ensure they are all inclusive (MCM 4).
decisions.quote: the stormwater bylaws are in place, but need to be reviewed to insure they are all inclusive.

decisions.decision: The last two MCM 5 BMP categories (green infrastructure; street design and parking lot guidelines) should be combined.
decisions.quote: it was determined that the last two: allow green infrastructure and street design and parking lot guidelines, should be combined.

decisions.decision: The NOI MCM 1 section is left as written for now, with further discussion on September 13.
decisions.quote: it was determined to leave the noi as is for now, and to have further discussion on this topic at the september 13 swtf meeting.

decisions.decision: The SWTF will vote on submission of the new NOI at its September 13 meeting; a September 27 meeting is set for final tweaks if needed.
decisions.quote: the swtf will take a vote on submission of the new noi at its september 13 meeting.

decisions.decision: The Town Manager will be asked to sign the NOI; the SWTF Chair will set up an NOI review meeting with Ms. Lemieux and have it placed on the Board of Selectmen's agenda before September 13.
decisions.quote: manager will be asked to sign the noi; the swtf chair will set up a meeting for noi review with ms. lemieux

decisions.decision: The SWMP BMPs for MCM 1 and MCM 2 will be reviewed at the September 13 meeting.
decisions.quote: the stormwater management plan (swmp) bmps for mcm 1 and mcm 2 will be reviewed at the september 13 swtf meeting.

decisions.decision: Agenda items c. and d. are deferred to a future meeting because Land Use Director Burney was absent.
decisions.quote: land use director burney was not able to attend the meeting, so agenda items c. and d. will be taken up at a future meeting.

decisions.decision: Agenda item e. is deferred to a future meeting because Conservation Commissioner Jack Rabbitt was absent.
decisions.quote: conservation commissioner jack rabbitt was unable to attend the meeting, so agenda item e. will be taken up at a future meeting.

decisions.decision: The group will begin using the Activity Log template for Education and Outreach, with one column added, and refine it as needed.
decisions.quote: one column of information was added; the group will begin to use this, and refine as needed.
